title: W2 VERIFY (text against source): audit-born ratios read against their actual homes
description: Wave 2's text-against-source audit, the T-361 pattern, with the wave's own signature failure mode: a record that reads F1 or U1 as though it had F6's standing. F6 became a standing ORCHESTRATION.md rule and a verdicted registry record; U1 and U3 live only in the planner's agent-definition file; F1 never generalized past one mdtoc-specific fix. Your job is to read each ratio against the home it cites and refuse any record that borrows authority from a sibling label. You audit the canonical id set T-384 forwarded. Rotation (F6): identity distinct from T-380, T-381, T-384 and every producer.
acceptance_criteria: INPUT IS T-384's CANONICAL LIST - quote it. Audit every record on it against the home its sources cite.
TEXT-AGAINST-SOURCE, SIDE BY SIDE: quote the home's sentence and the record's ratio next to each other and state ENACTS / NARROWS / WIDENS / DRIFTS. WIDENS or DRIFTS is a REJECT.

THE REACH TEST, this wave's central check: for each of F1, U1, U3, U2 and U4, confirm the record states WHO it binds and WHERE the duty lives, and that a reader cannot mistake an agent-file convention for a standing harness rule. A record that presents F1 or U1 with F6's standing is a REJECT even if every citation resolves.
F6 NOT RE-MINTED: confirm no wave-2 record duplicates PR-004's norm; a connection to it must be a follows or cites relation, never a second record.

NO STALE LINE ANCHOR SHIPPED: for every path:lines token in sources and validity, open the file at that range and confirm the cited lines actually contain the cited content. path:lines resolves on file existence alone (PRECEDENT.md section 5.1), so cite and conflicts will both pass a stale range - this is the only place it gets caught.

NO SHADOW DUPLICATE: check each new record's norm against all pre-existing records, not just wave 2's.
